title: A Weather for the Inventory
author: Juniper Fairweather
blurb: Lior Kavanagh, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
